company.name: Cityblock Health
company.shortDescription: Cityblock Health is a tech-driven healthcare provider that offers comprehensive and personalised care for underserved communities.
company.description: Cityblock Health is a tech-driven provider for communities with complex needs it focuses on investing upstream in highly personalized, prevention-oriented health and social care to ultimately drive down costs and improve outcomes. Its technology enables scale by bringing together practical information, coordination, and communication for its members and care teams. During COVID-19, Cityblock created a model to help organizations determine which of their members are at high risk of COVID-19.

productsAndServices.description: A coordinated care model combining medical services, mental health support, and social care assistance for Medicaid and Medicare members with complex needs.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series E round raised $116,000,000, or 11.52% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $20,431,595 to $2,386,514,831, a 116.81x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 78 (-14 over 90 days) and market heat at 93 (+19).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include AbsoluteCARE, Pluto Health, Recovery.com.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
